description: Land Title Settlement Department - Aluthgama Bogamuwa, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511800
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
